items.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analyst Views Turn More Divided
items.summary: Nvidia's fair value estimate has been trimmed from $328.72 to $319.99, reflecting a slightly more cautious stance on the stock. Recent analyst commentary has become more divided, with bulls pointing to AI demand and ecosystem breadth, while bears highlight governance questions, financing exposure and long term visibility, which helps explain why price targets are being adjusted rather than reset. items.title: Your Family’s Bills Are Still Rising — But the Government Can’t Tell You By How Much
items.summary: A shutdown last fall left a hole in the government's inflation data, and the number most households use to judge their budgets is missing. Rebuilding it from the index levels that do exist reveals why the Fed and bond traders are on edge.
